response.sql:
WITH line_items_with_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    derived_product_cost,
    CASE
      WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL AND product_price != 0
      THEN derived_total_cost / product_price
      ELSE NULL
    END AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND product_price IS NOT NULL
),
invoice_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
    AVG(ratio) AS invoice_ratio
  FROM line_items_with_ratios
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM invoice_metrics
),
above_average_invoices AS (
  SELECT
    im.avg_product_cost,
    im.invoice_ratio
  FROM invoice_metrics im
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE im.invoice_ratio > os.overall_ratio
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
  AVG(invoice_ratio) AS average_ratio,
  AVG(invoice_ratio) - (SELECT overall_ratio FROM overall_stats) AS average_distance_above
FROM above_average_invoices

assumptions.assumption: Invoice ratio is calculated as the average of per-line-item ratios (AVG(derived_total_cost / product_price)), rather than the ratio of sums (SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(product_price)).
Line items with product_price = 0 are treated as having an undefined ratio and excluded from the invoice's average ratio calculation.

alternatives.interpretation: Invoice ratio is the ratio of aggregate totals across all line items: SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(product_price).
